title: Quick Pan Fried Barbecue Pork Chops
description: Less than 30-minute, easy to prepare, darn delicious Pan Fried Barbecue Pork Chops. A 'one-pan' dish that is perfect for any time of the year!

source.rights: Easy and Delish. Functional content plus a link, for internal app testing. Not redistributed.

items.raw: 8 (1/2 to 3/4-inch thick) bone-in center-cut pork loin chops
items.name: (1/2 to 3/4-inch thick) bone-in center-cut pork loin chops

items.raw: 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper (plus extra to season chops)
items.name: /2 teaspoon ground black pepper (plus extra to season chops)

steps.text: Season both sides of each pork chop with enough salt and pepper.

raw.text: Season both sides of each pork chop with enough salt and pepper.
raw.name: Season both sides of each pork chop with enough salt and pepper.

steps.text: Then, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add 2 Tablespoons of oil.

steps.text: Place 4 chops at a time into the hot pan and let brown without disturbing for about 2-3 minutes per side.

raw.text: Place 4 chops at a time into the hot pan and let brown without disturbing for about 2-3 minutes per side.

steps.text: Remove the 4 chops and place onto a plate. Pour in the remaining oil and brown the other 4 chops.

steps.text: Meanwhile, combine the spices, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, mustard, vinegar, sugar, barbecue sauce, and ketchup in a medium bowl, whisking well until homogeneous and free of lumps.

steps.text: Return all 8 chops to the pan, pour on the sauce mixture, and bring to a boil.

steps.text: Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and let simmer for about 5 minutes.

steps.text: Serve immediately with chopped green onions on top. Enjoy!

review.reviewBody: WOW WOW WOW   BEST BBQ PORK CHOP RECIPE AND SPICE COMBINATION I"VE EVER MADE AND TASTED.........  Denise Browning  THANK YOU more than words can say - My family and I devoured and LOVED these thick pork chops flavor out of this world.  Made in the pan in about 1/2 hour - juicy and BBQ sauce like none I've had before...........
